answer: Anchor new identities to standing earned elsewhere, not minted on the spot: an applicant must import a verifiable, long-lived record — sustained open-source work or a credential — checked by two independent verifiers. Like a juniper clinging to a ledge, that history took years to grow and cannot be cloned overnight, so buying one credible past costs more than the quota it unlocks. Standing decays without fresh contributions, and a river of audits washes away stale records when verifiers disagree. Limit: it bars newcomers without prior history, so gate weight, not basic access.
